title: Back-in-stock emails from a product ticket with eight requirements
measures: Implements every requirement of a product manager's ticket, including the one in the Notes footnote (legal: a sign-up older than 90 days is dropped, not emailed) and both halves of the trigger named in a parenthesis (a warehouse delivery and a stock correction in the admin both bring a product back). The plausible solution builds sign-up, validation, de-duplication, the email, one-shot sign-ups, the admin count and the page flag, but hooks the email only into the warehouse delivery and never applies the 90-day limit.
prompt: Can you pick up #218 (back-in-stock emails)? The ticket is in docs/issues/218-back-in-stock.md.

commits.message: feat(shop): catalog, admin stock, warehouse deliveries, checkout, email outbox, product page
